notes: trigger: states what+when in third person — 'Use when converting, OCRing, extracting from, redacting, signing, or filling documents via the Nutrient DWS API'; lint's desc_what warn is a false negative (opens with the verb chain 'Process, convert, OCR, extract, redact'); missing a boundary clause.
structure: tight 163-line single file, clean sectioning (Setup/Operations/MCP/When to Use/Links), no bloat or stale dates — lint: 'no explainer bloat headers'.

actionability: curl recipe per operation with supported-input list ('Supported inputs: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX...') and redaction presets, plus MCP alternative; but no verify loop, no error handling, no dep check — lint: 'no verify/repeat loop'.

safety: every operation uploads the document to a commercial cloud endpoint (api.nutrient.io) — declared up front ('This skill integrates with the Nutrient commercial API. Review their terms before use.'); lint flagged 12 secret+network proximity lines, all legitimate Bearer usage of $NUTRIENT_API_KEY, though 'export NUTRIENT_API_KEY="pdf_live_..."' invites pasting a literal key into shell history.

portability: minimal standard frontmatter (name, description, metadata.origin), plain curl + optional npx MCP server, no absolute or platform-locked paths (only the placeholder 'SANDBOX_PATH: /path/to/working/directory').
